name: switch
title: Switch
description: On or off, with no words: a #262626 track with a gray thumb when off, White with a Black thumb when on. The thumb slides on the strong ease-out.
use_for: A setting that takes effect at once: a digest, an alert, a sharing option. The row beside it says what it turns.
never: On and Off written beside it
A switch with no line saying what it does
A spectrum color for the on state
A choice that waits for a Save button: use a checkbox
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no switch in the brand assets): White as the one primary state, the button's secondary fill, the brand corner
